name: BetterClaw
description: Intelligent device context, event filtering, and proactive insights for BetterClaw iOS

triageModel.description: Model for per-event triage. Defaults to primary/default, which uses the OpenClaw session's default agent model without requesting a plugin model override. Concrete model refs require plugins.entries.betterclaw.subagent.allowModelOverride=true unless triageApiBase is set.

triageApiBase.description: Optional base URL for OpenAI-compatible triage endpoint. When set, triage uses direct OpenAI-compatible HTTP instead of the OpenClaw subagent runtime.

pushBudgetPerDay.description: Max events forwarded to agent per day

patternWindowDays.description: Days of event history for pattern computation

analysisHour.description: Hour (system timezone) for daily analysis run

defaultCooldown.description: Default dedup cooldown in seconds for subscriptions not in deduplicationCooldowns

calibrationDays.description: Days of calibration before learner profile influences triage decisions
